limitations: The larger artifact limit was declared after inspecting original failures and Graphify results; this is not the original protocol or held-out evidence.
God-node retrieval measures a native hub ranking, not validated god-object classification. The four positive and four none judgments are partial external labels, not population precision.
The original Compass CloudStack timeout and Eclipse artifact-limit failure remain visible in mlcq_god_audit_review.json.
Compass Eclipse reuses a frozen partial graph with 62 omitted edges. Source-assisted public resolution and neighbor checks do not replace ranking retrieval.
Compass uses unoptimized development builds; timings do not establish release performance or a controlled Graphify speed ranking.

Graph counts, graph consistency and source-coordinate coverage do not establish semantic edge precision, responsibility synthesis, authored explanation quality, functional communities or overall superiority.

wholeRepositoryProfiling.interpretation: The full CloudStack follow-up wall time includes a two-second process sample. It is an operational observation, not a controlled speed comparison. The separately completed 24 SQL file timings were not sampled or changed.
